newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0805 CDT.
LIVE CATTLE - Up 0.150 to off 0.150 cent. Higher beef supportive but futures at premium and higher grain calls bearish to deferred months.
FEEDER CATTLE - Off 0.200 to 0.300 cent. Sharply higher grain futures and lower index.
LEAN HOGS - Steady to off 0.200 cent. Steady to lower cash hog markets on larger hog runs.
PORK BELLIES - Steady to up 0.100 cent. Product again firmed but larger kill ideas may temper demand.
